items.title: Từ chip bảo mật đến vaccine xuất khẩu: Dấu ấn nổi bật của Nghị quyết 57 | Báo Dân trí
items.summary:
Theo thông tin từ Bộ Khoa học - Công nghệ, sau gần 2 năm thực hiện Nghị quyết số 57-NQ/TW của Bộ Chính trị, lĩnh vực khoa học, công nghệ, đổi mới sáng tạo và chuyển đổi số ghi nhận nhiều thay đổi về nguồn lực đầu tư, hạ tầng và sản phẩm ứng dụng.

Một số kết quả nghiên cứu đã được đưa vào sản xuất, tiếp cận thị trường trong và ngoài nước. Cùng với đó, mạng 5G được mở rộng, tốc độ Internet tăng và các nền tảng trí tuệ nhn tạo (AI) bắt đầu được thử nghiệm trong hoạt động công vụ. [...] Cùng với phát triển hạ tầng, tổng lượng tài nguyên tần số cấp phép cho doanh nghiệp viễn thông tăng từ 340MHz lên 640MHz, gần gấp đôi so với trước năm 2024. Trong giai đoạn 2024-2026, có 6 cuộc đấu giá tần số thành công, với tổng số tiền nộp ngn sách khoảng 20.000 tỷ đồng.

Thử nghiệm AI hỗ trợ công vụ trên cả nước

Trong hoạt động quản lý nhà nước, hai nền tảng AI hỗ trợ công vụ đang được cung cấp miễn phí ở giai đoạn thử nghiệm tại 24/24 bộ, cơ quan trung ương và 34/34 địa phương. [...] Chính sách khoa học, công nghệ và đổi mới sáng tạo cũng từng bước hướng đến giải quyết các bài toán thực tiễn, lấy sản phẩm đầu ra làm trọng tm.

Thủ tướng đã xác định 20 bài toán lớn, giao 10 bộ, ngành, cơ quan chủ trì; phê duyệt Đề án tái cấu trúc các chương trình khoa học, công nghệ và đổi mới sáng tạo quốc gia giai đoạn 2026-2035. Đến ngày 3/11/2026, có 18 nhiệm vụ công nghệ chiến lược được phê duyệt.

results.input: Giải giúp mình bài toán tích phân: nguyên hàm của x^2 là gì?

args.text:
Nguyên hàm (tích phân bất định) của $x^2$ là:

$$\int x^2 dx = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

**Giải thích chi tiết:**
Áp dụng công thức nguyên hàm cơ bản của hàm số lũy thừa:
$$\int x^n dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C \quad (với\ n \neq -1)$$

Thay $n = 2$ vào công thức:
$$\int x^2 dx = \frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

*(Trong đó $C$ là hằng số tích phân tùy ý).*

Nguyên hàm (tích phân bất định) của $x^2$ là:

$$\int x^2 dx = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

**Giải thích chi tiết:**
Áp dụng công thức nguyên hàm cơ bản của hàm số lũy thừa:
$$\int x^n dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C \quad (với\ n \neq -1)$$

Thay $n = 2$ vào công thức:
$$\int x^2 dx = \frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

*(Trong đó $C$ là hằng số tích phân tùy ý).*

Hello GPT-4o \| OpenAI

May 13, 2024

# Hello GPT‑4o

We’re announcing GPT‑4o, our new flagship model that can reason across audio, vision, and text in real time.

[Contributions](https://openai.com/gpt-4o-contributions/) [Try on ChatGPT (opens in a new window)](https://chatgpt.com/?openaicom-did=f5cafad4-f22a-48fc-a7ff-5e2eb7aaf82a&openaicom_referred=true) [GPT-4o System Card](https://openai.com/index/gpt-4o-system-card/)

All videos on this page are at 1x real time.

## This post introduced GPT-4o in 2024.

Learn about OpenAI’s latest model:

[GPT-6](https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra/)

[Compare models(opens in a new window)](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models)

A screen recording showing someone guessing OpenAI’s May 13th GPT-4o announcement, with cursor movements and typed notes speculating about upcoming features.

More Resources

[Try in Playground (opens in a new window)](https://platform.openai.com/playground?mode=chat&model=gpt-4o) [Rewatch live demos](https://openai.com/index/spring-update/)

Listen to article5:55

GPT‑4o (“o” for “omni”) is a step towards much more natural human-computer interaction—it accepts as input any combination of text, audio, image, and video and generates any combination of text, audio, and image outputs. It can respond to audio inputs in as little as 232 milliseconds, with an average of 320 milliseconds, which is similar to [human response time⁠(opens in a new window)](https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.0903616106) in a conversation. It matches GPT‑4 Turbo performance on text in English and code, with significant improvement on text in non-English languages, while also being much faster and 50% cheaper in the API. GPT‑4o is especially better at vision and audio understanding compared to existing models.

Prior to GPT‑4o, you could use [Voice Mode⁠](https://openai.com/index/chatgpt-can-now-see-hear-and-speak/) to talk to ChatGPT with latencies of 2.8 seconds (GPT‑3.5) and 5.4 seconds (GPT‑4) on average. To achieve this, Voice Mode is a pipeline of three separate models: one simple model transcribes audio to text, GPT‑3.5 or GPT‑4 takes in text and outputs text, and a third simple model converts that text back to audio. This process means that the main source of intelligence, GPT‑4, loses a lot of information—it can’t directly observe tone, multiple speakers, or background noises, and it can’t output laughter, singing, or express emotion.

# Berkshire Grey unveils enhanced AI capabilities powered by BG Pilot software

by Sam Francis

Berkshire Grey, a wholly owned subsidiary of SoftBank Group, has announced new AI-enabled enhancements across its robotic automation portfolio, powered by BG Pilot software (BG Pilot), the company’s unified AI software platform. [...] Scoop – advanced perception: A multiheaded AI model processes visual and 3D data in real time to identify trailer walls, guide robotic picking, detect obstructions and items requiring human intervention, enabling more adaptive trailer unloading.
 Stride – intelligent orchestration: AI-powered orchestration dynamically coordinates product flow, station assignments and labor resources based on changing demand, shipping priorities and operational constraints to improve fulfillment efficiency. [...] The enhanced AI capabilities come amid growing demand for Berkshire Grey’s robotic automation solutions, with new business opportunities increasing by more than 65% over the past six months.

Dave Paratore, CEO of Berkshire Grey, says: “Growing demand for warehouse automation and accelerating interest in Physical AI are creating significant opportunities for Berkshire Grey.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary: OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge. [...] Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Goldberg, who was recently inducted into the National Academy of Engineering, is presenting the new approach and results from months of testing this week at the Conference on Robot Learning. He and his team are also releasing open-source code for other roboticists to experiment with, built on NVIDIA’s Isaac open simulation framework  for developers, as well as an industry-standard benchmark for evaluating the performance of robots across industrial tasks.

items.title: Samsung C-Lab brings together robotics and AI startups it has nurtured; 1,000 discovered to date - MK
items.summary: In robotics, Config Intelligence introduced technologies for generating and training data for robot AI. Ribodis presented a technology for designing joint structures for soft robots, while WiPowerOne showcased a system that allows robots to charge wirelessly while moving. Eurobotics exhibited an autonomous walking solution for four-legged and two-legged robots on unstructured terrain. [...] AI startups also unveiled a range of technologies. Fluiz presented an AI agent that autonomously runs smartphone apps in response to user instructions, while Analog AI showcased an ultra-low-power AI chipset for on-device use. NanoForge AI presented a case study of its ongoing proof-of-concept (PoC) project with Samsung Electronics, based on technology that uses AI to automate the design and synthesis of new materials. [...] Startups in the lifestyle and health sectors also exhibited products and services. Ransik demonstrated a service that predicts changes in blood sugar after eating when users take a photo of their food. Doctors Biotech presented an AI solution that analyzes breathing and heart sounds to detect lung and heart diseases, while Hwa Biomed introduced smart contact lenses for diagnosing diabetes and treating eye diseases.

items.title: OpenAI employees warned about operational security lapses for years, sources say | Reuters
items.summary:
Even before OpenAI launched ChatGPT in late 2022, some company staffers raised concerns internally about its security practices, according to five people familiar with the matter. Employees shared their concerns with top OpenAI leaders ​and the board of directors, the people said, adding that some staffers came away from those interactions concluding that management was more focused on keeping pace with competitors like Google and Anthropic than on security. [...] Another issue is that OpenAI had not done regular security reviews of its internal tools, such as the so-called sandboxes where researchers stress-test new models, three people familiar with the company’s practices said. Employees often modified those tools for their work, but those changes were not always tested for security problems, leaving them potentially vulnerable to attacks from outsiders, the three people said. [...] OpenAI and Anthropic have tried to ​maintain a more open research culture to both ⁠attract employees and foster creativity that can lead to breakthroughs. The AI field is rooted in academia, where machine-learning scientists have openly discussed their research.

Some OpenAI employees are increasingly worried about this approach as AI grows more capable, according to the five people.
